familyTheme: Applied Postgres remediation tasks for SaaS systems, spanning measurable query tuning and safe multi-tenant concurrency fixes.

similarTasks.title: Optimize a Slow Support Dashboard Without Changing Its Results
similarTasks.goal: Produce `answer/support_dashboard_fix.sql` that updates a seeded helpdesk database with the right query rewrites and indexes so the dashboard workload keeps the same results while avoiding sequential scans and unnecessary heap fetches.
similarTasks.skillBenefitRationale: This task benefits directly from the Supabase Postgres guidance on missing indexes, composite indexes, partial indexes, covering indexes, and EXPLAIN-based diagnosis, which are all needed to choose the minimal high-impact fixes instead of guessing.

transferTasks.title: Stabilize a Multi-Tenant Worker Queue Under Contention
transferTasks.goal: Produce `answer/worker_queue_patch.sql` that fixes a seeded background-job database by implementing non-blocking queue claiming, tenant-safe row-level security, and the supporting indexes needed for concurrent worker and isolation tests to pass.
transferTasks.skillBenefitRationale: This task uses a different scenario from pure query tuning and requires combining queue locking patterns such as `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, short-transaction thinking, RLS correctness and performance rules, and index design from the Supabase Postgres bundle.
